content: Many effects last until the end of the target's next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), abbreviated as "(EoT)" in the [tier outcomes](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/tier-outcome) for an ability's [power roll](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.dice/power-roll). A creature suffers from such an effect until the end of their next [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn), or the end of their current [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn) if the effect was imposed on their current [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn).
name: End of Next Turn (EoT)
